summary: Mazda's China-built electric mid-size SUV shares the 6e sedan's 78kWh LFP rear-drive platform and lists at $53,990 for the GT, under the Tesla Model Y and BYD Sealion 7, with Australian reviewers praising its design, cabin materials and rear-seat space. They split on the drive, with Chasing Cars finding it typically Mazda and better than the Sealion 7 while CarExpert calls it generic and heavy, but agree the 26.45-inch screen that runs almost everything, nagging driver-assist alerts and a modest boot hold it back. Both grades sit well under the $75,000 FBT exemption cap, and reviewers consistently pick the GT because the Azami adds mainly 21-inch wheels and digital mirrors for $56,990.
pros: GT's $53,990 list price undercuts the Tesla Model Y RWD ($58,900) by $4,910 and the BYD Sealion 7 ($54,990) by $1,000, and it was advertised at $56,990 drive-away until 31 December 2026
484km WLTP range on the GT's 19-inch wheels, and Chasing Cars measured 15.3kWh/100km on test, enough for around 510km
Rated to tow 1,500kg braked with Mazda's genuine towing kit, plus an 83-litre frunk
Roomy second row and a well-finished cabin with a 23-speaker audio system, where the Model Y and Sealion 7 have 12 or fewer
Eight-year or 160,000km high-voltage battery warranty on top of the unconditional five-year, unlimited-kilometre vehicle warranty, and five years of scheduled servicing capped at $1,860
cons: Boot is 363 litres to the cargo cover (468 to the roof) with a high floor and only a tyre repair kit, small for a mid-size SUV
Almost every control runs through the 26.45-inch touchscreen, which CarExpert, CarsGuide and Chasing Cars all criticise, and the driver-assist alerts are frequent and over-sensitive
At 2,155kg it is about 200kg heavier than a base Model Y, and the Azami's 21-inch wheels cost ride comfort and 16km of WLTP range
Five-year vehicle warranty trails the seven years Kia, MG and GWM offer, and the car had no ANCAP or Euro NCAP rating at launch

New nameplate with no Australian resale history, and Mazda was already offering a $56,990 drive-away deal on the GT (about $150 under the computed Victorian drive-away) by late September 2026, as deliveries began
